The season began on 17 July 2026 and will end on 29 May 2027. One team was promoted from the [[2025–26 Second Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|2025–26 Second League]], and another place is for the winner of the [[2025–26 First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)#Promotion/relegation play-off|promotion/relegation play-off]]. The only team to earn promotion from the Second League was [[FC Dunav Ruse|Dunav]], who mathematically secured the Second League championship after drawing against [[FC Fratria|Fratria]] on 12 May.{{#invoke:cite|web| title = Дунав Русе се завръща в Първа лига | url = https://bnrnews.bg/shumen/post/468528/dunav-ruse-se-zavrashta-v-parva-liga | publisher = bnrnews.bg | date = 12 May 2026 | language = bg}} Dunav returned to the top level after a 6-year absence. In the promotion/relegation play-off, [[PFC Septemvri Sofia|Septemvri]] won against [[FC Yantra Gabrovo|Yantra]], thus remaining in the First League.{{#invoke:cite|web| title = Септември (Сф) уби надеждите на Янтра за елита след обрат и груба вратарска грешка | url = https://sportal.bg/news-2026052812511738265 | publisher = sportal.bg | date = 28 May 2026 | language = bg}} Additionally, this is the first season since [[2008–09 A Group|2008–09]] without [[PFC Beroe Stara Zagora|Beroe]], as they were relegated after 17 consecutive years in the top flight.{{#invoke:cite|web| title = Берое загуби гостуването си на Ботев Враца и изпадна във Втора лига | url = https://bntnews.bg/news/beroe-zagubi-gostuvaneto-si-na-botev-vraca-i-izpadna-vav-vtora-liga-1394702news.html | publisher = bntnews.bg | date = 22 May 2026 | language = bg}} {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center;" |- !
